This story is not a story but an emotion that every person has experienced sometime in their lives. In adulthood when everyone is struggling to cope up with life, career and needs, they find themselves confused and perplexed. This confusion  further becomes complex when nothing is working out inspite of doing everything right. 
This is to tell everyone that no matter what happens, we should not stop fighting for our dreams, because 
"Everything you can imagine is true"
